title: The irrationality exponent of π is 2

result.label: The irrationality exponent of π is 2
result.statement: Proves that the irrationality exponent of π is exactly 2: for every ε > 0 and all sufficiently large denominators q , every rational p/q satisfies | -p/q| q^ -2- . This also proves convergence of the Flint–Hills series n 1 1/(n^3 ^2 n), with angles in radians.
